newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oil reserves upgraded at 3 Norway fields-Idemitsu.
newsitem.headline: Oil reserves upgraded at 3 Norway fields-Idemitsu.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd announced on Thursday seismic data suggesting a 594 million barrel gain in oil reserves at Norway's Snorre, Tordis and Statfjord Ost fields in the North Sea.
Total reserves at the three fields total 1.57 billion barrels, the company said in a news release.
Idemitsu holds a 9.6 percent stake in each of the Snorre and Tordis fields, and a 4.8 percent stake in Statfjord Ost.
Idemitsu attributed the revised reserve figures to technological breakthroughs including horizontal drilling and alternating gas-and-water injection techniques.

According to the news release, the reserve upgrades, along with Idemitsu's 9.6 percent stake in the Vigdis field, plus other fields to which Idemitsu has potential claims, makes Idemitsu the largest producer and reserve holder among Japan's domestic oil companies.
